South Abbey Cottage, South Abbey, Youghal, Co. Cork, P36 K230
DNG Spillane are delighted to present South Abbey Cottage, a truly unique detached period residence located in one of Youghal's most historic and sought-after settings. This charming former gate lodge, dating from circa 1880, occupies a superb position just moments from Youghal's famous beachfront, boardwalk, Greenway and the wide range of amenities available within the town centre.
Extending to approximately 76 sq.m., this distinctive property offers purchasers a rare opportunity to acquire a home full of character and history while enjoying the convenience of modern-day living. Set along a private laneway, South Abbey Cottage enjoys a wonderful sense of privacy and seclusion despite being within easy walking distance of shops, cafés, restaurants, schools and recreational facilities.
Accommodation is bright, well laid out and full of charm throughout. The ground floor comprises an entrance hallway, living room, kitchen, W.C., shower room and a ground floor bedroom located within the rear extension. Upstairs there are two generously sized double bedrooms, creating a flexible layout suitable for a variety of purchasers including owner occupiers, holiday home buyers and investors alike.
The property benefits from gas-fired central heating and has been maintained over the years while retaining much of its original character and appeal. As a former gate lodge, the property enjoys architectural features and a distinctive appearance rarely found in today's market.
One of the property's notable features is its private rear yard, offering a useful outdoor amenity space that is both practical and easy to maintain. The enclosed setting provides privacy and creates an enjoyable space for outdoor seating and everyday use.
The location is undoubtedly one of the property's strongest attributes. South Abbey is regarded as one of Youghal's most desirable residential areas and enjoys immediate access to the town's many attractions. The Front Strand, Youghal Boardwalk, Greenway and numerous historic landmarks are all within a short stroll, while Cork City, Midleton and Dungarvan are easily accessible via the nearby N25.
Properties of this nature seldom come to the market. Combining period charm, historical significance, a detached setting and an exceptionally convenient coastal location, South Abbey Cottage represents a unique opportunity to acquire a truly special home in the heart of East Cork's popular seaside town.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the character, charm and potential this property has to offer.
